name.en: 10% off Device Insurance setup fee when bought with Unlimited 5G

description.en: Applies a 10% discount to the Device Insurance initial/setup fee line item when the cart also contains the Unlimited 5G Plan (the bundle wrapper, the sellable plan, or any of its three fees).

cartPredicate: lineItemCount(product.key = "telco-5g-bundle" or product.key = "5g-unlimited-plan" or product.key = "5g-unlimited-initial-fee" or product.key = "5g-unlimited-monthly-fee" or product.key = "5g-unlimited-yearly-fee") > 0
